statements.t: Through strategic and disciplined organic growth, expansion of export markets and/or acquisitions, we intend to participate in other international markets where cannabis attains legal status.

As a result of the typically higher margins in international markets (predominantly due to lower taxation compared with Canada), we expect international expansion to enhance our profitability while expanding our brand and experience into emerging legal cannabis markets.

The Company’s capacity expansion project at its Delta 2 greenhouse in British Columbia remains on track to be completed during Q1 of 2027 and expected to ramp to its full production capacity by the middle of next year.

The Groningen facility is now fully planted, and the Company continues to expect it will ramp to its maximum annualized production capacity in early 2027, positioning Village Farms Netherlands for stronger revenue growth next year.
We intend to use our cash on hand for daily operational funding requirements.
We can provide no assurance that, in the future, we will be in compliance, or receive a waiver for any non-compliance of the financial covenants.
We expect to meet our contractual obligations and commitments using our working capital and our other resources described under “Capital Resources” above.
Other than with respect to our long-term debt described above and our Canadian and Netherlands expansion projects, we currently do not have any material cash requirements in the near future.

As we’ve previously discussed, we continue to expect our competitive advantage with the world’s largest single-site EU-GMP certified cannabis facility will result in continued increases in demand for our compliant production capacity, and we are looking forward to our Delta 2 expansion contributing to stronger international sales growth next year along with our entrance into multiple new European jurisdictions.”

“We’re pleased to report that our Phase II Netherlands facility is now fully planted and expected to begin contributing to stronger sales growth during Q4 and throughout 2027.
Our Delta 2 expansion remains on track to reach its full production capacity by the middle of next year, positioning us for continued long-term organic sales growth through calendar year 2028.
Finally, we’re actively mobilizing plans to operationalize our standalone 30-acre greenhouse in Monahans, Texas for cannabis production.
